Our story

Nostalgic treats. Real memories. Viral vibes.

Air Batu Viral celebrates the flavours many of us grew up with — reimagined as a colourful, constantly changing experience. From neighbourhood freezers to TikTok and events, we keep the rasa nostalgia alive.

Local brand. Big flavour. No boring freezer.
